speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor (Superior Sulcus Tumor). The mass at the right lung apex is compressing the lower brachial plexus (C8-T1), causing your right arm weakness, sensory loss, and aching pain. This explains why your symptoms are unilateral and progressive despite your steroid use. Given the significant weight loss and smoking history, a biopsy would be the next logical step to confirm the malignancy type and stage the disease.
